exact_statement: For every finite legal P0 reference prefix whose state satisfies validate_reference_state and whose periodic generator invariant holds: (1) the three abstract cases SAME_TIMESTAMP_CLOSURE, READY_SERVICE_OR_EARLIER_BOUNDARY, and IDLE_JUMP_TO_MINIMUM_FUTURE_EVENT are exhaustive and mutually exclusive as proved by Z3; (2) same-time closure decreases a lexicographic rank as proved by Z3; (3) same-time generated events enter only a strictly higher phase as enforced by the executable contract; (4) every step_reference successor is revalidated by validate_reference_state; and (5) periodic successor strict futurity and period congruence are proved by Z3.
